mintAuthority.summary: cNGN's native issuance surface is the Africa Stablecoin Consortium CNGN issuer account on Bantu. Authored destination deployments retain the reviewed representation model, with Solana's native-versus-representation accounting unresolved. No issuer-side economic cap or timelock is established. Current issuer-linked August and September ISAE 3000 reports compare reserves with circulating liabilities, but publication/signing chronology, omitted Lisk scope and excluded freeze/test-token owedness prevent admission as whole-supply reconciliation.

controls.evidence: At Bantu ledger 34,127,652, which closed at 2026-08-16T23:02:58Z, the official issuer account GD6G2NT7CQHPIYHA52KZHWB6ONNWTSGZOOLTRLRASENM2VWSF6CHYFRX had low/medium/high thresholds 2/2/3, its master key at weight 3, and three additional live signers at weight 1: GC2VTKYPQWTLCFTJKIWE2EPS5CRCAKPOUNQK34QDDJIN4TA2UX37HJVX, GCBWCKIW4GXWP7OPSCPCXU7IJ5W4A7ZM5YDGF3GETMRLZSW6YXCKMZKE, and GCRIACITUDK7ATFOM2P2ZJBO6FTYZKF2DX2PDE4IS3QNYOL2SWSBNURF. The CNGN asset record reported 887,344.1732650 units across 217 accounts with auth_required, auth_revocable, and auth_clawback_enabled. cNGN's FAQ and the Bantu Foundation identify this Bantu asset as the native issuance ledger; no issuer-side cap or timelock was evidenced.

review.evidence: The cNGN FAQ and Bantu Foundation case study identify Bantu as the native issuance ledger and describe lock-and-mint destination representations. The native CNGN issuer and asset were read at Bantu ledger 34127652 on 2026-08-16; no issuer-side economic bound or timelock was established. Solana's independent native liability and reconciliation are not proven, so the reviewed representation disposition is retained. Correction researched 2026-10-20 without renewing the original review pin: the earlier inference of reconciliation none from unreachable reports was invalid. The issuer's current client-rendered archive publicly links August and September 2026 ISAE 3000 examinations. September Table 1 compares NGN4,209,411,443.67 reserve assets with NGN3,953,275,819.97 circulating cNGN; Table 3 names Bantu plus seven destination chains but omits catalogued Lisk, and note 10 excludes freeze/test tokens without establishing their owedness. Practitioner and management signatures on pages 5 and 7 are undated; no public-release date is established. A recurring all-liability reconciliation has not been admitted, but its absence has not been positively proved: reconciliation is unknown, not none. Unbounded native issuance, the external-only-representation exception, unresolved upgrade scope and all other known control facts remain.

noLocalIssuance.rationale: Every deployment currently authored in the catalog is a destination representation: the five EVM routes are supported by the Bantu lock-and-mint architecture, and Solana is conservatively classified as a representation because independent native issuance is unproven. Native issuance is verified on Bantu, but bantu is not a registered catalog chain identifier and therefore cannot be authored as a route or contract row within this scoped migration. This explicit exception prevents the untracked Bantu issuer control from implicitly targeting a destination route.
